info.name: Finance Backend API — Complete Test Suite
info.description:
End-to-end Postman collection for the Finance Backend API.

─── HOW TO USE ───────────────────────────────────────────
1. Import this file into Postman (File → Import)
2. Make sure your Spring Boot app is running on http://localhost:8080
3. Open the Collection → Variables tab and confirm baseUrl = http://localhost:8080
4. Run requests in the ORDER they appear in each folder.
   The very first request is 'Login as Admin' — it auto-saves the token.
   Every other request uses that token automatically.

─── WHAT GETS AUTO-SAVED ────────────────────────────────
After login → the JWT token is saved to the collection variable 'authToken'
After create user → new user's ID saved to 'createdUserId'
After create transaction → transaction ID saved to 'createdTransactionId'
You never need to copy-paste IDs or tokens manually.

─── CREDENTIALS ─────────────────────────────────────────
Admin login → username: admin | password: admin123
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

variable.description: Base URL of the running Spring Boot server. Change port here if you modified application.yml.

Auto-filled after 'Create Transaction — INCOME'. Used in subsequent transaction tests.
Auto-filled after 'Create Transaction — EXPENSE'. Used in filter tests.
